configurePresets.name: perlmutter
configurePresets.description: module load PrgEnv-nvidia cudatoolkit cray-libsci. Single rank (TERCO_ENABLE_MPI=OFF: pic-mpi's serial backend; perlmutter-mpi is the multi-rank build). Bare nvc/nvc++/nvfortran, Cray libsci for BLAS/LAPACK, cc80, and an explicit CUDA version so -cudalib finds math_libs/13.2/lib64.

configurePresets.name: perlmutter-mpi
configurePresets.description: Multi-rank runs. Cray MPICH needs pic-mpi's legacy `mpi` backend, and libterco must be STATIC: in libterco.so nvfortran binds MPI_IN_PLACE's common block (mpifcmb5_) locally, libmpifort sees the executable's copy, and every in-place allreduce segfaults (and nvfortran's handler spins on it). Run with MPICH_GPU_SUPPORT_ENABLED=0 and srun -u.

configurePresets.name: frontier-cpu
configurePresets.description: module load rocm. Host build, no GPU offload (TERCO_ENABLE_GPU=OFF), single rank. amdflang for Fortran, Cray cc for C, OpenBLAS for BLAS/LAPACK. -z execstack because ld.lld refuses json-fortran's object, which flang marks as needing an executable stack (nested callbacks passed as arguments).

configurePresets.name: frontier-gpu
configurePresets.description: module load rocm. Needs the OpenMP-converted source (tools/dc_to_omp.py then tools/acc_to_omp.py, both --target gpu, on src test app): the OpenACC source has no data movement under amdflang. TERCO_ENABLE_HIP adds -fopenmp --offload-arch=gfx90a and links hipBLAS/hipSOLVER.

configurePresets.name: gadi
configurePresets.description: source gadi_envsh (nvidia-hpc-sdk, openmpi/5.0.5, intel-mkl, cmake/3.31.12). Single rank (TERCO_ENABLE_MPI=OFF). nvfortran/nvc/nvc++ wrappers, sequential LP64 MKL for BLAS/LAPACK, cc70 for the gpuvolta V100s.

configurePresets.name: gadi-mpi
configurePresets.description: Multi-rank runs. OpenMPI's mpifort/mpicc/mpic++ wrappers (nvfortran underneath, nvidia mpi_f08 bindings), so pic-mpi's default mpi_f08 backend is used.
